title.zh: 有限速度原子 slab 输运组合

summary: Review-only finite atomic slab candidate with synthetic tests for generation bookkeeping, stopping and selected input rejection; independent scientific validation is unknown.

capability: Review-only finite atomic slab transport composition
Synthetic behavior checks for generation accumulation and stopping.
operation: atomic slab inputs -> generation distributions, moments and stopping diagnostics
discovery.model: Candidate composition of a finite velocity mesh, incoming boundary, ionization, simple charge exchange, radiative recombination and moment reduction; no molecular or elastic source.
discovery.geometry: One spatial axis x in metres and normalized cylindrical velocity axes vr/vx; synthetic tests use four spatial samples.
discovery.boundary: Incoming positive-vx first flight and zero incoming scattered-generation boundaries; tested with an x-aligned zero pipe diameter.

identity.relation: atomic slab inputs -> generation distributions, moments and stopping diagnostics
identity.direction: candidate input mapping -> generation fields, moments and stopping diagnostics
identity.definition: Review candidate implemented only in catalog/review/candidates/src/scirel/kinetic/atomic_slab_transport.py; tests/conftest.py extends imports for the review harness. This is not an installed-wheel capability.
identity.model: Finite slab first-flight and scattered-generation composition with simple charge exchange and radiative recombination; scientific applicability is not established by the synthetic tests.
identity.geometry: One spatial axis with cylindrical velocity distributions shaped (nvr, nvx, nx).
identity.coordinates: profiles.x in metres, Ti/Te and incident energies in eV, profiles.n in m^-3; normalized velocity axes are returned.
identity.boundary: The current implementation passes incident.density_m3 directly as a boundary flux target; the synthetic tests do not validate that unit interpretation.
assumptions: The synthetic case supplies aligned x/Ti/Te/n arrays, positive temperatures and density, mu=2, mesh_size=3, one 3 eV energy and zero pipe diameter.
Stopping is controlled by a positive truncate threshold and an integer-converted max_generations value of at least one; reaching the cap returns diagnostics rather than raising for nonconvergence.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Candidate mapping with profiles, incident, configuration.kinetic_h, pipe_diameter_m and solver controls; see identity for the tested field interpretation.
inputs.constraints: The tests supply four aligned spatial samples, Ti=Te=5 eV, n=1e18 m^-3, positive boundary target and generation caps 1, 2 and 3. These values are synthetic inputs, not physical calibration.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: Distribution, generation_distributions, generation_count, axes, moments, source fields and generation_delta/stopped/stop_reason diagnostics from the review candidate.
outputs.units: mixed candidate field units; no independent unit validation asserted
outputs.constraints: The synthetic tests check finite field shapes, positive density, nonzero generations, distribution accumulation and stopping diagnostics. They do not establish independent physical correctness.

preconditions: Candidate imports require the repository review harness; this record does not declare an installed-wheel entry point.
The tested synthetic fields satisfy existing candidate and leaf input checks.
supported: Repository-local behavior checks on a four-point synthetic slab: finite outputs, generation caps, accumulated fields and threshold stopping.
excluded: Public package availability, generic-device applicability and release acceptance.
Reconstruction of the unavailable private case, independent physical validation and parameter-envelope or lower/upper-bound coverage.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Selected existing ValueError paths are tested: non-dict inputs; misaligned profiles; nonpositive temperatures; negative or nonfinite density; repeated x; nonpositive generation cap; zero/nonfinite truncate; invalid pipe text or shape. This is not exhaustive malformed-input coverage.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Leaf errors propagate; numerical overflow and other runtime failure paths are not exercised by this synthetic suite.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: When the generation cap is reached before threshold stopping, returns generation_stopped=False and generation_stop_reason='max_generations'; this is not an exception or proof of convergence.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial result on validation failure.

example.description: Repository review-harness example only, using the same synthetic fields as the direct tests; the submodule is not in the public wheel.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.atomic_slab_transport import solve_atomic_slab_transport
inputs = {"profiles": {"x": [0.0, 1e-4, 2e-4, 3e-4], "Ti": [5.0]*4, "Te": [5.0]*4, "n": [1e18]*4, "mu": 2.0}, "configuration": {"kinetic_h": {"mesh_size": 3}}, "incident": {"energies_eV": [3.0], "density_m3": 1e15}, "pipe_diameter_m": [0.0]*4, "solver": {"truncate": 1e-30, "max_generations": 3}}
result = solve_atomic_slab_transport(inputs)
assert result["distribution"].shape == (4, 8, 4)
assert result["generation_count"] == 3
assert result["generation_stop_reason"] == "max_generations"
example.expected: Synthetic candidate arrays with distribution shape (4, 8, 4) and three generations stopped by the configured cap; not an independent physical reference.

scope: Four-point synthetic slab with Ti=Te=5 eV, n=1e18 m^-3, mu=2, mesh_size=3, one 3 eV incident energy, boundary target 1e15 and zero pipe diameter; no external input file.
Generation caps 1/2/3: finite shapes, nonzero per-generation fields, accumulated distribution equal to their sum, preserved generation prefixes and increasing density across capped runs.
Threshold stopping at truncate=2 and truncate=1, plus the selected existing input rejection paths listed in failure_semantics.invalid_input.
